description: Change one existing constraint. Every field is optional and absolute, and only the ones present are written, so repeating a call is idempotent. The two nodes are the constraint's identity and cannot be changed: delete it and create another to re-target. 'enabled' is applied last and is not a plain flag — turning it off restores the child to the transform captured when the constraint was created (subject to reset_position/rotation/scale as this same call leaves them), turning it on re-captures the child's current transform as the new resting state. Offsets are not re-captured here the way studio_constraint_create captures them: read the current ones with studio_constraint_list and send the values you want. Requires the NodesConstraints plugin.

enabled.description: applied after every other field in this call

scale.description: refused when the child node is at the scene root

look_at.description: turn the child to face the parent instead of copying its rotation; the rotation offset decides which way is 'front'

position_offset.description: [x, y, z] in the parent's local space

scale_offset.description: [x, y, z] multipliers on the parent's world scale

position_damp.description: 0 snaps every frame; above 0 the child lags behind

position_locks.description: [x, y, z] booleans: true drives the axis, false leaves the child's own value

output.description: the constraint after the change, same shape as one entry of studio_constraint_list's 'constraints'
